title: Address Points
description: Address points from Sandy Utility Billing, Subdivision plats, parcel data. 60,400 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Prop_Subtype
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source layer's domain allows: `Apartment`, `Condominium`, `Duplex`, `Mobile Home`, `Elderly Housing`, `Commercial`, `Educational`, `Medical`, `Religious`, `Government`, and 8 more. Codes: `Apartment` = Apartment, `Condominium` = Condominium, `Duplex` = Duplex, `Mobile Home` = Mobile Home, `Elderly Housing` = Elderly Housing, `Commercial` = Commercial, `Educational` = Educational, `Medical` = Medical, `Religious` = Religious, `Government` = Government, `Land` = Land, `Townhome` = Townhome.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
